title: Gate value modulo an integer
statement: Fix a natural number $n$, and let $k$ be a natural number, $a$ a function from natural numbers to natural numbers, and $vs$ a list of natural numbers. The value of an input gate $x_i$ is $a(i)$ modulo $k$, and the value of the constant-one gate is $1$ modulo $k$. An addition, subtraction, or multiplication gate with indices $j,l$ has value, respectively, the sum, the sum of the left value and $k$ minus the right value, or the product of the entries of $vs$ at those indices, all modulo $k$; an out-of-range list lookup is interpreted as zero.
hypotheses_covered: Gate is one of the five constructors of an algebraic gate with $n$ inputs
